title: The Lion King
synopsis: Pride Rock. Your father is king. Your uncle has a plan. The savanna stretches forever, until it doesn't.

nodes.text: Sun, savanna, Rafiki lifting you above.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Stay close to Mufasa.” The story records the instinct as “Heart” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Spirit.

nodes.text: Scar tells you about it. You and Nala explore.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
There is no taking “Stay near home” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: They corner you. Mufasa arrives.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Stand.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Stars and ancestors. The kings of the past watch.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Believe.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Doubt” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Scar's plan. Wildebeests in the gorge.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.

nodes.text: Mufasa pulls you up. Scar drops him.

choices.consequence: You commit to “See it.” The story records the instinct as “Witness” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Spare—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Scar tells you to run. You believe him.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Run far.” The story records the instinct as “Survive” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Run nearby” back. Loyal shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Timon and Pumbaa. Bugs for dinner.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Friend.
There is no taking “Refuse” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Years pass. You forget the rock. You almost forget yourself.

choices.consequence: “Sing” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Joy.
There is no taking “Stay quiet” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: She finds you. The pride is starving.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Listen” back. Heart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He appears with a stick. He says your father lives in you.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Look in the water” back. Path shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: Remember who you are.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.
“Doubt” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Pride Rock is a wasteland. Hyenas everywhere.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Climb quietly” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.

nodes.text: Your mother sees you. Briefly, she sees Mufasa.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Embrace her.” The story records the instinct as “Heart” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Stand back” back. Honor shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He admits to killing your father.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Anger.
“Hold” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: Lightning. The rock burns.

choices.consequence: “Climb high” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.

nodes.text: He lies one more time.

choices.consequence: “Spare him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Mercy.
There is no taking “Throw him” back. Justice shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: They turn on Scar. The rock is yours.

choices.consequence: “Rain comes” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Renewal.
You commit to “Mourn the dead.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Rain on the rock. Sun after.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Roar.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Years later. Rafiki lifts your child.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Hold Nala's hand” back. Family shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.

nodes.text: You teach your child the stars. The cycle is, again, a circle.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You rule for decades. The savanna heals. Songs are sung about you. Some of them, sweetly, are about Pumbaa.
You build a council with hyenas at the table. The pride disagrees. The pride is, in the end, stronger for it.
You die old. Your cub becomes the next ruler. They, in turn, raise their own. The circle, you decide, is exactly as small as it ever was. And exactly as wide.
